sentence_cloze: There's ___ be something wrong with him!
sentence_full: There's gotta be something wrong with him!
translation: 他肯定有什么毛病！
cultural_note: gotta = got to 的口语连读，同类还有 gonna=going to、wanna=want to、hafta=have to。

sentence_cloze: So does he have a ___? A hump and a hairpiece?
sentence_full: So does he have a hump? A hump and a hairpiece?
translation: 他难道是个驼子？驼背上还戴着假发？
cultural_note: hump 本义驼峰/驼背；hairpiece 假发。Chandler 在夸张调侃 Monica 的约会对象。

sentence_cloze: (They all stare, ___.)
sentence_full: (They all stare, bemused.)
translation: （大家都一脸困惑地盯着Phoebe。）
cultural_note: 注意不要和 amused（被逗乐）搞混！前缀 be- + muse（沉思）→ 陷入沉思而发懵。

sentence_cloze: You and I have kinda ___.
sentence_full: You and I have kinda drifted apart.
translation: 我们俩这些年有点疏远了。
cultural_note: drift apart = 关系慢慢变淡；kinda = kind of。

sentence_cloze: I was more ___ this gravy boat than by Barry!
sentence_full: I was more turned on by this gravy boat than by Barry!
translation: 我居然对这个肉汁船（餐具）比对Barry更有感觉！
cultural_note: turn sb on = 使某人兴奋/有性趣（日常也可指对某事物很有热情）。Rachel 神比喻。

sentence_cloze: I was looking at this gorgeous Lamauge ___.
sentence_full: I was looking at this gorgeous Lamauge gravy boat.
translation: 我盯着那只漂亮的拉莫奇肉汁船看。
cultural_note: gravy 肉汁/酱汁；boat 船形器皿。西方餐桌上用来盛gravy的小船形碟子。

sentence_cloze: And then I got really ___.
sentence_full: And then I got really freaked out.
translation: 然后我就彻底慌了神。
cultural_note: freak out 口语高频：受惊、激动、情绪失控。也可说 sb freaks me out（某人吓着我了）。

sentence_cloze: Joey, stop ___ her!
sentence_full: Joey, stop hitting on her!
translation: Joey你别撩她了！今天是她逃婚的日子啊！
cultural_note: hit on sb 美式口语= 挑逗、搭讪某人；hit on an idea=忽然想到点子。

sentence_cloze: ___! (按门禁让他进来)
sentence_full: Buzz him in!
translation: 快开门让他进来！
cultural_note: 公寓楼的intercom（门禁对讲机）发出buzz蜂鸣声 → buzz sb in = 按开门键放某人上楼。

pos: n. phrase 值得写进日记的大事
sentence_cloze: Ooh, this is a ___.
sentence_full: Ooh, this is a Dear Diary moment.
translation: 哇哦，这可是值得写进日记的历史性时刻啊！
cultural_note: Chandler式吐槽：Dear Diary… 相当于「我要把这天写进我的少女日记里」，故意煽情以制造幽默。

sentence_cloze: (Ross is ___ and reading the instructions)
sentence_full: (Ross is squatting and reading the instructions)
translation: （Ross蹲在地上读说明书。）
cultural_note: squat 深蹲（健身）/ 蹲坐；另外也指擅自占住空屋（squatter=占屋者）。

pos: n. phrase（瞎编的）那个支架玩意儿
sentence_cloze: I'm supposed to attach a ___ to the side things.
sentence_full: I'm supposed to attach a brackety thing to the side things.
translation: 说明书说要把「那个支架玩意儿」装到「旁边那些玩意儿」上。
cultural_note: Ross不知道零件名，在thing/things前加-y后缀瞎编：brackety=像bracket的东西，worm guys=螺丝钉（像小虫子）。

pos: n. phrase（瞎编的）螺丝小子们
sentence_cloze: using a bunch of these little ___.
sentence_full: using a bunch of these little worm guys.
translation: 用一堆这些小螺丝小子（不知道名字瞎叫的）。
cultural_note: guy 可以指物，不一定是人，相当于「玩意儿」：the little guy=小家伙/小零件。

sentence_cloze: (Ross is ___ a beer can and sniffing)
sentence_full: (Ross is clutching a beer can and sniffing)
translation: （Ross攥着一罐啤酒，闻来闻去。）
cultural_note: clutch = hold tightly（紧紧抓住，常因激动/害怕）；也可做名词=离合器。

sentence_cloze: If you're gonna start with that stuff we're ___.
sentence_full: If you're gonna start with that stuff we're outta here.
translation: 你再絮叨这些有的没的我们就走人了啊！
cultural_note: outta = out of；gonna = going to；都是美语日常快读的拼写。

sentence_cloze: You ___.
sentence_full: You got screwed.
translation: 你简直亏大了 / 你被坑得够惨。
cultural_note: screw 作动词= screw（螺丝钉）拧进去 → 被screwed=被坑、被榨干；也可粗俗版。日常: I screwed up=我搞砸了。

sentence_cloze: I guess I should have ___ when she started going to the dentist.
sentence_full: I guess I should have caught on when she started going to the dentist.
translation: 她一周去四五次牙医的时候我就该看出来不对劲了。
cultural_note: catch on = 理解、觉察；也可表流行：The song caught on quickly.（这首歌很快火了。）

sentence_full: Ooh, steer clear of you!
translation: 喔哟，那我可得离你远点！（你把男朋友浴巾都撕了啊）
cultural_note: steer 掌舵 + clear of 避开 = 绕开某人/某事走。Steer clear of trouble=别惹麻烦。

sentence_cloze: I ___ my boyfriend's favorite bath towel.
sentence_full: I shredded my boyfriend's favorite bath towel.
translation: 我把我前男友最爱的浴巾给撕成了碎条。
cultural_note: shred 碎条 → shred sth=切碎/撕成条；也可指健身练出的条状肌肉= shredded abs。

sentence_cloze: Hi, the machine ___ again…
sentence_full: Hi, the machine cut me off again…
translation: 喂，电话又把我给掐断了……
cultural_note: cut sb off 还可以：切断供给、打断别人说话、道路截断。

sentence_cloze: Four years at the end of which she ___.
sentence_full: Four years at the end of which she ripped your heart out.
translation: 四年感情，到最后她把你心都撕碎了。
cultural_note: rip=撕；rip one's heart out = 伤害极深。也可字面：rip the letter open. 撕开信。

pos: phrase 拿起勺子=重新开始约会
sentence_cloze: Welcome back to the world! ___!
sentence_full: Welcome back to the world! Grab a spoon!
translation: 欢迎回归单身大世界！赶紧「拿起勺子」（开撩冰淇淋妹子们）！
cultural_note: Joey用冰淇淋口味比喻女人，Ross担心「一辈子只吃一种口味」，Joey让他Grab a spoon= 赶紧拿勺去挖吧=重新开始约。

pos: n. 比喻 不同类型的女生
sentence_cloze: That's like saying there's only one ___ for you.
sentence_full: That's like saying there's only one flavors of ice cream for you.
translation: 说「一生只一个人」就好像在说「冰淇淋你只有一种口味」一样。
cultural_note: Joey最精彩比喻：Rocky Road / Cookie Dough / Bing! Cherry Vanilla → 各种女生。

pos: phrase （粗俗）他的小弟弟能重振雄风了
sentence_cloze: Before me, there was no ___ for two years.
sentence_full: Before me, there was no snap in his turtle for two years.
translation: 在我之前，他那玩意儿可是两年都没「弹」起来过哦。
cultural_note: snap 啪一声 + turtle 乌龟（龟头缩进去）→ 委婉粗口。Frannie告诉Monica Paul根本不是阳痿，他是在骗炮。

pos: phrase 是一句撩妹的套话
sentence_cloze: Of course it ___!
sentence_full: Of course it was a line!
translation: 那当然是骗你上床的鬼话啊！你居然信！
cultural_note: line在这里不是排队，是「套话/花言巧语」：pick-up line=搭讪开场白。

pos: n. 信标、灯塔般的信号
sentence_cloze: Is it like I have some sort of ___ that only dogs and men can hear?
sentence_full: Is it like I have some sort of beacon that only dogs and men with severe emotional problems can hear?
translation: 难道我身上装了什么「感情问题男+狗」专用信标吗？专门吸渣男？
cultural_note: 灯塔beacon → 能吸引特定目标的信号源。Monica吐槽自己总是吸引感情有问题的男人。

pos: phrase 什么技能都没学过
sentence_cloze: I'm ___! I was laughed out of twelve interviews today.
sentence_full: I'm trained for nothing! I was laughed out of twelve interviews today.
translation: 我什么专业技能都没有！今天面了十二家，十二家都把我笑出来了。
cultural_note: Rachel作为富家逃婚女，以前从来没工作过，大学=社交，所以啥也不会。这是她成长线起点。

pos: phrase 被轰着笑出来=面试惨败
sentence_cloze: I was ___ twelve interviews today.
sentence_full: I was laughed out of twelve interviews today.
translation: 今天十二场面试，我都被人笑着给请了出去。
cultural_note: laugh sb out of sth = 被嘲笑得自己呆不下去自己走了；非常生动的表达。

pos: adj. 乐观的、积极向上的
sentence_cloze: And yet you're surprisingly ___.
sentence_full: And yet you're surprisingly upbeat.
translation: （十二场面试惨败）你居然还能这么嗨？
cultural_note: upbeat 音乐节拍 upbeat=上拍 → 积极的、开心的。反义：downbeat=垂头丧气。

pos: n. 甜蜜低卡糖（代糖品牌名）
sentence_cloze: (to the waitress) ___?
sentence_full: (to the waitress) Sweet 'n' Lo?
translation: （给服务员）给我来两包「甜又低」（代糖）？
cultural_note: 美国经典代糖品牌名，玩梗 Sweet + Low（低卡）= Sweet and Lo（故意拼写成Lo）。

sentence_cloze: You and I have ___ apart.
sentence_full: You and I have kinda drifted apart.
translation: 我知道我们俩这些年有点疏远了。
cultural_note: kinda = kind of（有点）；sorta = sort of。口语中必须掌握的弱化词。

sentence_cloze: Finally, I ___ I'd better answer it.
sentence_full: Finally, I figure I'd better answer it.
translation: 我最后想：我还是接一下电话吧。
cultural_note: figure sth out = 搞清楚、想明白。高频得要死的短语动词，一定要吃透。

pos: adj. 羞愧到想死、囧爆了
sentence_cloze: Ross: (___) Hi.
sentence_full: Ross: (mortified) Hi.
translation: Ross（脸都丢尽了）：嗨……
cultural_note: mort- 词根=死亡（mortal）→ mortify=羞愧得想死。Ross刚离婚，看到老友尴尬爆了。

sentence_cloze: Stop ___! No, just leave my aura alone, okay?
sentence_full: Stop cleansing my aura! No, just leave my aura alone, okay?
translation: 别净化我的气场了！就让我的气场「浑浊」着吧行吗！
cultural_note: aura=气场/光环；New Age（新时代玄学）概念。Phoebe人设就是信玄学、按摩、水晶、前世。

sentence_cloze: Phoebe: Fine! ___!
sentence_full: Phoebe: Fine! Be murky!
translation: 行！那你就一辈子糊里糊涂下去吧！（Phoebe气Ross不领情）
cultural_note: murky=浑浊的、晦暗的。气场不清就murky；也可以说murky past=黑历史。

pos: phrase 让她去死吧/管她呢
sentence_cloze: No I don't, ___! She left me!
sentence_full: No I don't, to hell with her! She left me!
translation: 才不祝她幸福，她爱咋咋地！她甩了我啊！
cultural_note: to hell with X = 让X见鬼去吧！礼貌版：to heck with X。

sentence_cloze: Why does everyone ___?
sentence_full: Why does everyone keep fixating on that?
translation: 为什么你们所有人都揪着这点（她是拉拉）不放？！
cultural_note: fixate on sth =  obsessively focus on 死盯着不放。注意 fix / fixate 意思不同。

pos: phrase 接受得挺坦然、挺想得开
sentence_cloze: I told mom and dad last night, they seemed to ___.
sentence_full: I told mom and dad last night, they seemed to take it pretty well.
translation: 我昨晚跟爸妈说了，他们好像接受得挺平静。
cultural_note: take sth well/badly = 对某事反应如何。Ross撒谎，其实他妈凌晨3点打电话嚎没孙子了。

pos: adj. 歇斯底里的；极搞笑的
sentence_cloze: So that ___ phone call I got from a woman sobbing at 3:00 A.M.
sentence_full: So that hysterical phone call I got from a woman sobbing at 3:00 A.M.
translation: 哦所以那通凌晨3点歇斯底里哭嚎说抱不上孙子的电话…打错了？
cultural_note: hysterical 两个核心意思：1.情绪失控的；2.(口语)笑死我了=hysterical=hilarious。

pos: phrase 男人一点、拿出性欲来
sentence_cloze: You're single! ___!
sentence_full: You're single! Have some hormones!
translation: 你单身了啊！发情啊！约啊！做点男人该做的事啊！
cultural_note: hormone=荷尔蒙/激素。Joey粗暴逻辑：单身就该hormone满满出门撩妹。

sentence_cloze: What was that? A ___?
sentence_full: What was that? A wrong number?
translation: 那怎么回事？难道是打错了？（Monica拆Ross台）
cultural_note: wrong number 打错电话；It's the wrong number.=你打错了。

sentence_cloze: this is Rachel, another Lincoln High ___.
sentence_full: this is Rachel, another Lincoln High survivor.
translation: 各位这是Rachel，我们林肯高中的又一位「幸存者」（吐槽高中地狱）。
cultural_note: survive 存活→survivor。这里是黑色幽默：把高中比作灾难，大家都是撑过来的survivor。

pos: n. phrase 四个浑身湿透的伴娘
sentence_cloze: Or are we waiting for ___?
sentence_full: Or are we waiting for four wet bridesmaids?
translation: 你是打算现在说呢，还是等你那四个湿透的伴娘也赶过来再说？
cultural_note: Rachel穿湿婚纱冲进来，Monica调侃：你那四个同样被雨淋透的伴娘啥时候到？

pos: n. 无咖啡因咖啡（decaf缩写）
sentence_cloze: Monica: (pointing at Rachel) ___.
sentence_full: Monica: (pointing at Rachel) De-caff.
translation: Monica（对服务员指着Rachel）：给她无咖啡因的。（她已经够疯了别再加咖啡因）
cultural_note: decaffeinated 去掉咖啡因的→口语decaf/di-caff。美国咖啡店必懂词：regular=普通的，decaf=脱因。

sentence_cloze: and I started ___ 'Why am I doing this?'
sentence_full: and I started wondering 'Why am I doing this?'
translation: 然后我忽然开始想：我到底在干嘛？我到底是为谁在活？
cultural_note: I wonder if/whether… 我想知道…；wondering 就是Rachel觉醒的起点。

sentence_cloze: Now I'm guessing that he bought her the ___.
sentence_full: Now I'm guessing that he bought her the big pipe organ.
translation: 我押他给她买了个巨大的管风琴（肥皂剧剧情猜谜）。
cultural_note: pipe organ 教堂管风琴。他们在看西班牙语肥皂剧，大家瞎猜剧情。

pos: phrase 手气正顺、势如破竹
sentence_cloze: Listen, while you're ___, if you feel like you gotta make a Western omelet…
sentence_full: Listen, while you're on a roll, if you feel like you gotta make a Western omelet…
translation: 既然你现在手气这么顺（第一次冲咖啡成功），要不顺手再做个西式欧姆蛋？
cultural_note: on a roll = 连续成功、势头正好。Joey让Rachel做饭，结果咖啡难喝得被倒花盆里。

pos: n. 西式洋葱火腿蛋卷
sentence_cloze: make a ___…
sentence_full: make a Western omelet…
translation: 做一份西式欧姆蛋（火腿洋葱青椒蛋卷）。
cultural_note: omelet 蛋卷，也拼omelette。Western omelet=有火腿/洋葱/甜椒的经典款。

target_word: the barn raising scene in Witness
pos: phrase 《目击者》里集体建谷仓的经典温馨场面
sentence_cloze: last night was like all my birthdays, both graduations, plus ___.
sentence_full: last night was like umm, all my birthdays, both graduations, plus the barn raising scene in Witness.
translation: 昨晚就好比我所有生日+两次毕业典礼+《证人》里全村人建谷仓的温馨名场面加起来那么爽！
cultural_note: 1985电影《Witness》哈里森福特主演，Amish村民集体帮主角搭建谷仓的经典温馨群戏。Paul极度夸张说法。

pos: phrase 把那些数字输进去
sentence_cloze: If I don't ___… it doesn't make much of a difference.
sentence_full: If I don't input those numbers… it doesn't make much of a difference.
translation: 我再不把那些数字敲进去……（其实干不干都没差别）。
cultural_note: Chandler吐槽自己的工作：就是一堆无意义的数字录入（后期他自己也不知道自己干啥的梗）。

pos: n. phrase 地方剧场演出（非百老汇）
sentence_cloze: Would I have seen you in anything? — I doubt it. Mostly ___.
sentence_full: Would I have seen you in anything? — I doubt it. Mostly regional work.
translation: 我看过你的剧吗？—— 应该没有，主要都是地方小剧场（跑龙套）。
cultural_note: regional theater = 美国地方/地区剧场；百老汇=Broadway，外百老汇=Off-Broadway。

pos: phrase 一个真真正正的小男孩（匹诺曹梗）
sentence_cloze: Chandler (sings): 'Once I was a wooden boy, a little wooden boy...'
sentence_full: 'Look, Gippetto, I'm a real live boy.'
translation: 「看啊盖比特爷爷！我终于变成一个真正的小男孩了！」（Chandler黑Joey演过匹诺曹）
cultural_note: 匹诺曹经典台词。Gippetto=做木偶的老爷爷。Joey演过公园小剧场的Pinocchio。

sentence_cloze: I can't ___.
sentence_full: I can't stop smiling.
translation: 我控制不住，我满脸都是笑。（Monica跟Paul睡了之后美滋滋）
cultural_note: stop doing sth=停下做某事；stop to do=停下来去做。两者区别必考。

pos: phrase 嘴里含了个衣架（形容咧嘴笑到僵）
sentence_cloze: You look like you slept with ___.
sentence_full: You look like you slept with a hanger in your mouth.
translation: 你那样子就好像睡觉时嘴里叼了个衣架被撑开在那儿笑。
cultural_note: hanger 衣架；超级形象的毒舌比喻。Rachel损Monica也太会了。

pos: phrase 步子迈太大、想太远了
sentence_cloze: I think we are getting ___ here.
sentence_full: I think we are getting a little ahead of ourselves here.
translation: 我觉得我们想太远了吧（谈婚论嫁还早）。
cultural_note: get ahead of oneself = 太早下结论、操之过急。比如考试还没考就在想放假，就是ahead of yourself。

sentence_cloze: Oh, look, ___!
sentence_full: Oh, look, wish me luck!
translation: 快看快看，祝我好运！（Rachel准备出门找工作）
cultural_note: wish sb luck = 祝某人好运；Good luck!= 好运！Break a leg!（演员圈）祝好运。

pos: n. 那种叫「工作」的玩意儿
sentence_cloze: I'm gonna go get one of those (Thinks) ___.
sentence_full: I'm gonna go get one of those (Thinks) job things.
translation: 我决定去弄一个那种……叫「工作」的东西。
cultural_note: Rachel第一次意识到她需要找份工作。things=那个叫啥来着，很真实的口语。

target_word: push my Aunt Roz through Parrot Jungle
ipa: /pʊʃ maɪ ɑːnt rɒz θruː ˈpærət ˈdʒʌŋɡl/
pos: phrase 推着轮椅上的Roz阿姨逛鹦鹉丛林乐园
sentence_cloze: I'm ___ and you're having sex!
sentence_full: I'm pushing my Aunt Roz through Parrot Jungle and you're having sex!
translation: 我在佛罗里达推着Roz阿姨逛鹦鹉乐园呢，你却在床上爽？不公平啊！
cultural_note: Parrot Jungle（现在叫Jungle Island）是迈阿密著名热带鸟园。推老人逛公园 vs 泡汉子的反差。

pos: phrase 把Paul的改变归功于我
sentence_cloze: I ___ Paul. Y'know before me, there was no snap in his turtle.
sentence_full: I take credit for Paul. Y'know before me, there was no snap in his turtle.
translation: Paul的「重振雄风」那得归功于我，在我之前他两年都不行。
cultural_note: take credit for X = 把X功劳揽在自己身上；give credit = 承认某人的功劳。

sentence_cloze: a beacon that only dogs and men with ___ can hear?
sentence_full: a beacon that only dogs and men with severe emotional problems can hear?
translation: 就好像我自带雷达，只招狗和有严重情感创伤的男人？
cultural_note: severe=严重的；emotional problems=感情/心理问题。Monica自嘲渣男吸引体质。

sentence_cloze: Joey (___ again) I can't believe you didn't know!
sentence_full: Joey (bursts out laughing again) I can't believe you didn't know!
translation: Joey（又爆笑出来）：你居然没听出来那是套话！
cultural_note: burst out doing = 突然开始做某事（笑、哭）；burst into tears/laughter=突然哭/笑。

sentence_cloze: All right, c'mere, gimme your feet. (She starts ___ them.)
sentence_full: All right, c'mere, gimme your feet. (She starts massaging them.)
translation: 好了好了过来，把脚给我。（她开始帮Monica按摩脚）
cultural_note: massage n./v.按摩；Phoebe的职业就是masseuse（女按摩师）。

sentence_cloze: I found John and David boots ___, fifty percent off!
sentence_full: I found John and David boots on sale, fifty percent off!
translation: 我撞见John & David的靴子打折！半价！太爽了！
cultural_note: on sale 打折中（美）；for sale 出售中；50% off = 打五折。

sentence_cloze: John and David boots on sale, ___!
sentence_full: John and David boots on sale, fifty percent off!
translation: John & David靴子打折半价，就被我给捡到了！
cultural_note: X% off = 去掉X%=100-X折。20% off = 八折。Rachel靠购物疗愈面试惨败。
